title: Add site asks the template's questions in an optional "Customize your site" card and sheet; Create site is never blocked and sends the answers, or no brief
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/site-brief.test.mjs
S2: Run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/e2e/create-brief-sheet.test.mjs (a real browser over the wizard fixture; needs Chrome or Playwright's chromium)
S3: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

No popup opens on Create site: the form shows [data-questions-card] under the template card and the site address, above Create site, reading '4 questions' and 'Receive a site tailored to you.' (three single lines and no answers on the card since #1001)

Pressing the card draws [data-questions-sheet="1"] on the bottom edge of the panel; the required Sector question is first with a Recommended tag; Done, the X, a click on [data-questions-scrim="1"] and Escape each close it, keep the answers and give focus back to the card.
Create site with answers sends brief = {answers: {name, about, sector}, questionnaire: <64 hex>}; with nothing answered (or only spaces) the POST /api/sites body has no brief.
A 503 from GET /api/sites/questions shows [data-questions-card="failed"] with Try again, and Create site still posts without a brief; a template whose platform entry says apply:false shows no card.

Changing template keeps the answers the new set still asks (same id, value still offered), drops the rest, and the sheet (not the card, since #1001) reads 'Answers kept for this design: 1. Answers that no longer apply: 1.'
evidence: 07/10/2026, option C of the site questions redesign: the popup after Create site read as a blocking step; questions move into an optional card before Create site.
fence: The real wizard bundle in a browser over a fetch double serving the questionnaires. Not exercised: the real create door, a running CMS, the dsh page around the panel.
